properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-009 Account Created and Acted Suspiciously
properties.query:
let TriggeredTimeFrame = 24h;
let TriggeredUsers =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-009 Account Created and Acted Suspiciously" 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(TriggeredTimeFrame) 
| extend A = parse_json(Entities) 
| mvexpand A
| extend User = tostring(A.Name)
| where isnotempty(User)
| summarize make_list(User);
let timeframe = 10m;
SecurityEvent1 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2*timeframe) 
// A user account was created
| where EventID == "4720"
| where AccountType =~ "User"
| project creationTime = TimeGenerated, CreateEventID = EventID, Activity, Computer, TargetUserName, UserPrincipalName, 
AccountUsedToCreate = SubjectUserName, TargetSid, SubjectUserSid,MF 
| join kind= inner (
  SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(timeframe) 
  // A user account was deleted 
  | where EventID == "4726" 
| where AccountType == "User"
| project deletionTime = TimeGenerated, DeleteEventID = EventID, Activity, Computer, TargetUserName, UserPrincipalName, 
AccountUsedToDelete = SubjectUserName, TargetSid, SubjectUserSid 
) on Computer, TargetUserName
| where deletionTime - creationTime < 10m
| extend TimeDelta = deletionTime - creationTime
| where tolong(TimeDelta) >= 0
| where AccountUsedToCreate !in (TriggeredUsers)
| project TimeDelta, creationTime, CreateEventID, Computer, TargetUserName, UserPrincipalName, AccountUsedToCreate, 
deletionTime, DeleteEventID, AccountUsedToDelete,MF
| extend timestamp = creationTime, AccountCustomEntity = AccountUsedToCreate, HostCustomEntity = Computer
